podcast.body: Bruce Springsteen originally wrote this song for disco queen Donna Summer but ultimately decided to keep it for himself. Released in the fall of 1984, this "torchy melodrama" and "Florida operatic rock song" became a number seven hit for Springsteen and the E Street Band, showcasing his ability to incorporate different musical styles. "Bruce wound up keeping it for himself, but maintained its torchy melodrama. The Florida operatic rock song was a number 7 hit for Springsteen and the E Street Band in the fall of 1984."
